title: Counit computation of the open composition comparison on a K-injective complex
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq Y$ an arbitrary open, and suppose the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on X, Y and every open of each exist in one morphism universe. Put $V=h^{-1}(U)$, $j_X:V\to X$, $j_Y:U\to Y$, and $g:V\to U$. Let $L_X,L_Y$ be exact derived restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], with their fixed derived adjunctions $a_X,a_Y$ [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Write $F=Rh_*$, $G=Rg_*$, $R_X=Rj_{X*}$, $R_Y=Rj_{Y*}$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let $\alpha:F L_Y\cong L_X G$ be the fixed derived open-restriction comparison, and $\beta:R_X F\cong G R_Y$ the supplied isomorphism fixed by equality to the two normalized composition comparisons joined by $j_X h=g j_Y$, both from [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], with juxtaposition in Lean functor order. For every K-injective cochain complex I of structure-sheaf modules on V [def-pur-kinjective-complex], with A=Q(I), one has $L_Y(\beta_A)\,\varepsilon_{Y,G(A)}=\alpha_{R_X(A)}\,G(\varepsilon_{X,A})$, in Lean composition order. No cover and no restriction unit on an object of X is present.

proof.text: Substitute the equality fixing beta to the canonical composition. Let jX and jY be the inverse-image and base open inclusions, g the restricted morphism, and I a K-injective complex on the inverse-image open. The adjunction of exact restriction with jX direct image shows that jX direct image preserves K-injectives (the proved Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes API). Therefore I and jX_*I compute the source direct images. Expand the two normalized composition comparisons. Their determining right-derived unit equations identify their composite, after restriction to U, with the localized sectionwise composition identification for jX followed by h = g followed by jY.

Expand schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison into its four factors: the inverse exact-target composition comparison, the derived sectionwise identity, the K-injective-preserving composition comparison, and the exact-source localization comparison. The factorization equations for these right-derived comparisons identify it on jX_*I with the sectionwise identity of Tag 08FE. On every open W of U both composites of this identity and the underived counits evaluate to the same identification of sections of I on g inverse image W. The counits of restriction followed by open direct image are the canonical restriction identifications, so the equality is degreewise and commutes with the differentials.

Localize the degreewise equality through the homotopy and derived quotient functors. Apply the counit factorization of the derived adjunction, Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app, to identify the localized counits with those of schemeMVAdjunction. Cancel the exact-restriction and right-derived computation factors. This gives the displayed counit square at Q(I), without any assertion about a restriction unit on X. For the empty open the target derived category is zero; for the full open the computation is the normalized composition identity.
